public class Solution
{
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.nextLine();
        int l=s.length();
        int c=0;
        for(int i=0; i<l-1; ) {
            if(s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(i+1)) {
                int z = countConsecutive(s, i, l);
                if(z % 2 == 0)
                    c++;
                i += z;
            } else {
                i++;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(c);
        sc.close();
    }
    
    private static int countConsecutive(String s, int start, int len) {
        int count = 1;
        while(start + count < len && s.charAt(start) == s.charAt(start + count)) {
            count++;
        }
        return count;
    }
}
